task.description:
Validate test design for IN-UI-05..08 after rework. Verify every MUST requirement has runnable integration/E2E coverage, no skipped MUST tests, fixtures are isolated, and tests fail clearly when required environment is absent.

Specifically verify IN-UI-06 is no longer blocked and timeline feed validation is truly runnable in real backend conditions.
acceptance_criteria: IN-UI-05 MUST has runnable E2E coverage
IN-UI-06 MUST has runnable E2E coverage
IN-UI-07 MUST has runnable E2E coverage
Clear failure behavior when env prerequisites absent

result.summary: Validated test design rework for IN-UI-05..08. MUST requirements IN-UI-05, IN-UI-06, and IN-UI-07 each have runnable Playwright E2E coverage in a real-backend flow, no skipped MUST tests were found, fixture isolation is maintained via unique seeded correlation keys and dedicated instance fixtures, and failure paths include explicit context-rich error messages. IN-UI-06 timeline coverage is no longer blocked: setup now waits for timeline readiness and the test asserts non-empty timeline API payload before UI assertions.
